correctness.rationale: Complete proof uses the unique u,p,v,w expansion in two fiber bits, the exact normalized cocycle identity, edge connectivity to force w=0 and v rows constant, rowwise rank-two alternating matrix identity for p/t, and independent n-dimensional coboundaries. The graph classification follows by nonzero F2² labels. The direct full cochain-matrix checker tested 60 connected graphs and showed 13/25 rank strata on all 38 connected labeled four-vertex graphs. Finite tests are corroboration, not infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Explicit examination of Furuki–Tamaru 2024 §4 and Saito–Sugawara 2024 §3 found the graph-quandle construction and its trivial-base abelian extension but not degree-two binary cohomology of the expanded quandle. García Iglesias–Vendramin 2015 requires indecomposability, inapplicable to Q_G. A previously published graph-quandle retraction-rank polynomial governs endomorphisms, not cochain cohomology. Semantic mathematical record queries for graph-quandle H², adjacency rank, binary cocycles and abelian extensions returned no matching coverage. This is originality relative to inspected statements, not a guarantee of first publication.
residual_risks: A broader, uninspected formula for cohomology of disconnected medial or abelian-inner quandles might imply this dimension without stating it in graph terminology.
Originality is a mathematically reasoned comparison with inspected sources, not an exhaustive proof of publication priority.

value.rationale: Determines an entire quandle extension invariant for all connected simple graphs, with a sharp equivalence to complete bipartite/tripartite structure. The invariant is naturally motivated by binary quandle 2-cocycles and abelian extensions, and goes beyond a small table or a variant of retraction enumeration.
